description: This file defines the Vtiger_PDF_Model class which manages a set of key-value pairs with methods to set, get, count, and retrieve keys, likely serving as a data model for PDF-related operations within the Vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: Vtiger_PDF_Model
classes.description: A class representing a simple data model for PDF generation, encapsulating key-value pairs with basic manipulation methods.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the model's internal storage.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given key, returning a default if the key is not set.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of key-value pairs stored in the model.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns an array of all keys stored in the model.
